title: Snapback Guide page frontmatter
description: Compatible core shared with the Exact guide (title, id, order, audience, capabilities, authorities, examples, status, reviewed) plus Snapback extensions (targets, maturity, authoring-profiles, reviewed-authorities-digest). Frontmatter uses the flat YAML subset: scalar values and inline arrays only. @ref LLP 0061#design — schema artifact required by the conventions.

id.description: Stable dotted id; reserved as the projection resource id (MCP, console).

capabilities.description: Capability-index ids this page claims coverage of; [] for meta pages.

authorities.description: Repo-root paths (LLPs and code). Freshness compares their current bytes against reviewed-authorities-digest.

examples.description: Repo-root paths of demos/files exercising what the page teaches.

targets.description: Which execution targets the page's claims hold for; [all] only for genuinely target-independent material.

maturity.description: shipped: teach normally. partial: page must name what works and what does not. design-only: marked design-reference sections only, never a technique.

authoring-profiles.description: Authoring profiles the page teaches. [] means profile-neutral; dual-profile pages use [explicit, familiar] in that order. Required for every new or materially edited authored page; unchanged legacy pages are temporarily content-bound by scripts/guide-authoring-profiles.mjs.

since.description: Published closure version in which this page's surface first became or is expected to become available.

unreleased.description: The whole page deliberately describes a surface newer than the newest published closure.

reviewed.description: Date of last intentional review — display metadata, never identity.

reviewed-authorities-digest.description: Digest of the declared authority bytes at the last intentional review — the rebase-stable freshness identity.
